entries.name: Christian Counseling & Educational Foundation (CCEF)
entries.creator: Founded 1968 by Jay Adams and John Bettler
subject: Biblical Counseling
entries.doctrinal_basis: Affirms the unique authority of Scripture and subscribes to the Apostles’ and Nicene Creeds, the Westminster Confession of Faith, the London Baptist Confession and the Heidelberg Catechism; Protestant and grounded in the Reformed tradition.
points_to_weigh: It also seeks to serve Christians from a range of theological perspectives, so its writers are not all from one church tradition.
Biblical counseling is not a substitute for medical or clinical care. If you or someone you know is in crisis or danger, call your local emergency number or, in the U.S., call or text 988.
entries.description: Biblical counseling ministry and training organization near Philadelphia, publishing articles, videos, podcasts, books and the Journal of Biblical Counseling.
